sloka: तमालोक्य महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।निवार्य शरजालानि प्रदुर्द्राव स रावणम् ।। ६.५९.५३ ।।।।
transliteration: tamālokya mahātejā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।nivārya śarajālāni pradurdrāva sa rāvaṇam ।। 6.59.53 ।।।।

translations.english: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.
